leverage.exposure: The balance is negative and must be back to non-negative before the matchday locks, or the entire matchday scores zero. That risk outranks everything else on this page. Two unwind legs exist and they are mutually exclusive — selling both drops the squad to ten and triggers the penalty. There is one more market-value tick before the lock, and both legs are rising, so the standing instruction holds: do not sell before tonight's tick. The hard fallback deadline leaves a comfortable margin after it. Georg chose to list Gruber as a manager ask rather than sell instantly; that ask is well above the band manager asks actually clear at and has drawn no offers since it went up, so expect it to sit. It costs nothing while it sits, and the instant-sale fallback covers it.

binding_gap: Goalkeeper, and it is unfillable rather than merely unfilled. Neuer is the only keeper and still carries a fitness flag. A full sweep this run turned up nothing newer than two days ago: no diagnosis, no return date, no training report. Kompany's own words were that he did not know whether it was days or weeks and did not think it was serious. The club's own matchday preview, published since, mentions him only conditionally — a hedge in a statistics piece, not a status. Every startable keeper on the board fails for a reason that is not price: one is blocked while the balance is negative, one cannot be unwound without leaving too few outfield players, one is priced far outside any band, and the cheap backup insures nothing because a keeper at the floor price does not start and scores the same zero as an injured Neuer would. The decisive source is Friday's Bayern press conference, which lands before the lock with hours to spare. Hold the slot and read Friday.
